values.note: A permit and reservation are always required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/delaware/camping ('A permit and reservation is always required for motorized, roadside camping', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23610 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Checkin Time: 3:00 pm'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site, O017 White Deer (Owego loop), along PA 402 about 2.5 miles south of US 6 (2 miles north of I-84). Pull-in on a 300-ft gravel driveway; site 50 x 50 ft, shaded, 15-ft overhead clearance. Limited to 2 vehicles. No max vehicle length is given, and the booking site files it under Tent Site only.

note: Delaware State Forest motorized roadside site O017 (White Deer, Owego area) along PA 402 about 2 miles north of I-84. One shaded pull-in site on a long gravel driveway, limited to 2 vehicles; the entrance drive is not plowed. No water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 570-895-4000. --Claude
